GT Biopharma, Inc., through its subsidiary Oxis Biotech, Inc., discovers, develops, and commercializes therapeutics from its proprietary product platform in various disease areas in the United States. The company has market cap of $70.67 million. The firm is developing drugs focused on the treatment of cancer. It currently has negative earnings. The Company’s lead drug candidates include OXS-2175, a small molecule therapeutic candidate targeting the treatment of triple-negative breast cancer; OXS-4235, a small molecule therapeutic candidate to treat multiple myeloma and associated osteolytic lesion; and OXS-1550, a bispecific scFv recombinant fusion protein-drug conjugate that targets cancer cells expressing the CD19 receptor or CD22 receptor, or both receptors.
